toron mail coordination surfaces

Usage: flywheel mail [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  inbox         fetch inbox (default: config identity; override with --as / FLYWHEEL_MAIL_AS / AGENT_NAME)
  reply         reply to a message in its thread (thread = the message id or thread id)
  read          mark a message read (read receipt; the projection honors it once read-state lands toron-side — bd-5icg)
  ack           acknowledge a message that had ack_required=true
  search        FTS5 search over the project's indexed messages
  summarize     summarize a thread (participants, key points, action items)
  whois         resolve an agent's profile (npub, program, model, task)
  register      register/refresh an agent identity (upsert). One operator is one identity (bd-register-portability-3c2b): a name is REQUIRED — bind an existing key with --from-project/--adopt-unnamed instead of minting
  renew         renew this identity's file reservations (extend the TTL)
  force-unlock  operator force-release of a stale reservation (herdr-down / abandoned)
  slot          build slots: acquire/renew/release the advisory 'cargo' slot
  policy        set this agent's inbound contact policy
  digest        per-agent mail digest: unread/urgent counts + last sender/subject (orchestrator "who has mail" view; default = own identity)
  watch         wait until a thread gains a new message (blocks; Ctrl-C to abort)
  send          send a message to registered agents
  locks         reserve / inspect file locks (advisory; subcommands: reserve, list, show)
  unlock        release this identity's reservations
  conflicts     check reservation conflicts for paths
  agents        list registered agents in the project (active within 24h by default; --all shows the full history incl. stale registrations)
  contact       cross-project contact (request_contact / respond / list)
  resend        ADR-0010 D8 (bd-d8e4): corr-preserving resend. Re-runs the send under the SAME corr — toron's idempotent claim dedupes within TTL and the receipt stays corr-keyed. Refuses resulted (resend would duplicate) and degraded (bookkeeping failed after enqueue — likely delivered). A plain re-run of `mail send` mints a NEW corr and duplicates
  product       product grouping for multi-project search/inbox
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --robot-snapshot      Full JSON state snapshot of all flywheel swarms (scripts/agents)
      --robot-capabilities  List flywheel's machine-readable capabilities as JSON
      --skip-preflight      Skip preflight checks (steer/loop/workflow auto-verify before dispatch)
      --robot-status        Compact JSON status of all flywheel swarms
  -h, --help                Print help
